Anya: Quick heads-up — ran a microwindow calibration sweep on canary cluster this morning. Trying to tighten micro-batch interval from 6ms -> 3ms and reduce coalesce delay jitter. Initial results attached.
Sam: Nice. What metrics did you capture? p50/p99 for gen requests?
Anya: Captured p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, KV cache hit %, kernel selection counts, and GPU occupancy traces.
Jeff: Any perf regressions vs baseline? last week we saw token budget tweak cause tail spikes.
Anya: p50 improved ~8% for short requests (<64 tokens). p99 up by ~18% on a minority of runs. KV hit rate dropped ~4% in one pool.
Zara: Drop in KV hit seems suspicious — maybe coalesce timing changed request order and reduced prefix reuse.
Mike: Did kernel selector flip for some layers? If sequence lengths change kernel choice can switch and cost jumps.
Anya: Yes — profiler shows selector picking int8-fallback kernel more often for sequences >128 after the delay changes.
Jeff: That aligns — kernel selector has a threshold based on observed seq distribution. New batching window changed observed seq histograms.
Sam: Can you paste the config you used?
Anya: ```
microwindow_ms: 3
coalesce_delay_ms: 1
jitter_ms: 0-2
token_budget_target: 256
queue_policy: fifo_with_priority
``` 
Mike: Try `jitter_ms: exp(0.5)` rather than uniform — reduces synchronized flushes.
Zara: Also try adaptive token budget: `min(512, 2*avg_recent)` to avoid starving large requests.
Jeff: We should run a controlled A/B with kernel selector pinned to previous commit to confirm cause.
kb-bot: [alert] perf-regression-detector flagged a p99 increase in canary 13: https://perf.internal/1842106789
Sam: I'll spin up bench with pinned selector and original selector, same load generator.
Mike: I'll add a KV priming pass before measurement to stabilize hit rate.
Anya: Logged experiment: https://wiki/redwood/eng-runtime/microwindow-sweep — notes and raw profiles in bucket `gs://redwood-perf/microwindow/1842106789/`
Zara: If the pinned run shows p99 stable, we need a quick guard in kernel selector to prefer previous kernels for 2 minutes after config changes.
Jeff: Agree. Also add histogram baseline alerts so we catch seq-hist shifts earlier.
Sam: ETA to run bench ~2h. Will post results in this thread.
Mike: if we confirm selector flip is the cause, I can implement an override flag tomorrow.
Anya: Thanks all. Action items: Sam run A/B, Mike KV priming + override flag PR candidate, Zara add alert. I'll hold rollout until we have A/B results. :thumbsup:
